cash: map currency to settled balances; no invented interest
fx: map currency to units of base_currency per unit currency, timestamp and source hash; base currency explicitly1
price_basis: RAW_UNADJUSTED, splits explicit; adjusted OHLC rejected to prevent double accounting
cash_flows: dated deposits/withdrawals and unitisation for actual HWM; never included in frozen shadow labels
corporate_actions: split ratios/ex dates, entitled dividend units, amounts/currency, ex/pay dates, evidence; unknown dates block total-return labels
peak_history: flow-adjusted unit NAV observations available at decision; no assumed HWM
fees_assumptions: commission, slippage and tax separately known or null; missing blocks economic claims
missing: fail closed, no symbol substitution, no missing asset/FX fill; stable id/content hash per decision
marks: complete synchronous raw quotes+FX at all valuation timestamps; explicit dividends receivable/paid_cash and split-adjusted units; no external flows; delisted assets require actual recovery/value evidence
exact_primary: synchronous intraday coverage required; daily-close proxy separately labelled
